models_evaluated: general-purpose LLM with in-built speech recognition

links.outcome: Errors in LLM-generated radiology reports including confabulations, rewording, non-compliance
links.effect: In the LLM group: 69 instances of rewording without loss of meaning, 99 instances of non-compliance to instructions and 4 confabulations; grammar/spelling and transcription errors were fewer than CSR (79 vs 293; 225 vs 445).
links.quote: In the LLM group, 69 instances of rewording without loss of meaning, 99 instances of non-compliance to instructions and 4 confabulations were observed.

unlisted_practices: Comparing a general-purpose plug-and-play LLM with conventional speech recognition for radiology report generation time and error types

screen.reason: Prospective comparative study in routine clinical practice evaluating radiologists using a general-purpose LLM with speech recognition versus conventional speech recognition for generating radiology reports.
